content.page_summary: Reference list (citations 806–815) from a clinical guideline focusing on sleep-disordered breathing in heart failure and studies of statins (rosuvastatin) in chronic/systolic heart failure.

citations.citation: Pearse SG, Cowie MR. Sleep-disordered breathing in heart failure. Eur J Heart Fail 2016;18:353–361.
citations.note: Review/summary on sleep-disordered breathing in patients with heart failure.

citations.citation: Cowie MR, Gallagher AM. Sleep disordered breathing and heart failure: what does the future hold? JACC Heart Fail 2017;5:715–723.
citations.note: Discussion of future directions linking sleep-disordered breathing and heart failure.

themes: Sleep-disordered breathing and central sleep apnea in heart failure (adaptive servo-ventilation, transvenous neurostimulation, phrenic nerve stimulation).
Multiple randomized trials and analyses assessing rosuvastatin/statins in chronic or systolic heart failure (CORONA, GISSI-HF) and meta-analysis showing limited/no benefit for some outcomes.
